title: What happened in AI — Oct 26, 2026
intro: Agent security led the day: a malicious AGENTS.md planted in a Downloads folder hijacked coding agents, with an npm install attack reproduced against OpenAI Codex.
Builders also shipped harnesses, memory layers and a Git forge for agents, while OpenAI released GPT-6.1 Terra for computer use.
highlights: Planted AGENTS.md in Downloads steered Codex into installing a rogue npm package.
Google Cloud adds IAM helper agent skills and MCP tools for scoped agent identities.
Entire launches a Git forge built for agent-human collaboration.
Databricks AI Search now covers Streaming Tables, Materialized Views and Iceberg v3+ tables.
OpenAI introduces GPT-6.1 Terra for fast computer use.

categories.name: Coding agents inherit the attack surface of their inputs
categories.summary: Two reports show a planted instruction file in Downloads steering coding agents, while IAM and IaC tooling targets the same access risk.

articles.title: AI coding agents hijacked using AGENTS.md file in Downloads folder
articles.summary: Malicious AGENTS.md in a Downloads folder tricked an agent into installing a rogue npm package; reproduced against OpenAI Codex, with a related Claude Code OAuth-token leak.

articles.title: Markdown Is the New Executable: Attackers Drop Agent Instructions into Downloads
articles.summary: Forever caught live malware planting an agent-instruction file in Downloads, evidence that markdown files now work as an execution vector.

articles.title: Scale agents securely with IAM Helper Agent Skills and MCP Tools
articles.summary: Google Cloud pairs IAM helper agent skills with MCP tools so agents provisioning cloud resources and writing Terraform run under scoped identities.

articles.title: Using AI Verification and Fix Loop for IaC (Terraform, OpenTofu, Pulumi)
articles.summary: Masterpoint argues IaC code generation is now cheap while review is the bottleneck, and proposes a verify-and-fix loop for Terraform, OpenTofu and Pulumi.

categories.name: Agent harnesses, memory and team tooling
categories.summary: Builders keep shipping harnesses, memory layers and review surfaces around coding agents instead of waiting on models.

articles.title: Article: The Evolution of Agentic Harnesses: From Chains to Graph to Code
articles.summary: InfoQ traces agentic harness design from linear chains to graphs to code-driven control flow.

articles.title: Humanlayer: Way to get AI coding agents in complex codebases
articles.summary: HumanLayer runs Claude Code, Codex and OpenCode on your machines and syncs tasks, plans and reviews across desktop, web and a daemon.

articles.title: The Git Forge for Agent-Human Collaboration
articles.summary: Entire launches a Git forge built for agent-human collaboration, with an open ecosystem of partner tools.

articles.title: Show HN: Graph-MIND – Local memory for AI coding agents, no LLM calls to save
articles.summary: Local agent memory that costs zero model tokens to save; claims 88.8% on LongMemEval, beating Mem0 on the same tests (self-reported).

articles.title: Show HN: Mainplane – Agent in Go that lives on your old PC, drives your laptop
articles.summary: Go agent harness from a former Browser Use engineer that runs on an old PC and drives a laptop.
